faqs.q: What is NIMCET?
faqs.a: NIMCET is a national entrance exam for MCA admission at participating NITs and other institutes. It is conducted once every year.

faqs.q: Who can apply for NIMCET?
faqs.a: Students with a qualifying bachelor's degree and the required Mathematics or Statistics background can apply, subject to the current rules.

faqs.q: How many questions are there in NIMCET?
faqs.a: NIMCET has 120 questions divided into Mathematics, Logical Reasoning, Computer Awareness and General English sections.

faqs.q: What is the NIMCET exam pattern?
faqs.a: NIMCET is a computer-based test with multiple-choice questions. Each section has its own marks, time and negative marking rules.

faqs.q: How is the NIMCET rank calculated?
faqs.a: Your marks are calculated using the official marking scheme, and candidates are then ranked based on their overall performance.

faqs.q: How are DPPs organised?
faqs.a: DPPs are organised by subject and chapter, so you can practise one topic at a time without searching through long PDFs.

faqs.q: Where do I find previous year papers?
faqs.a: Open the PYQs section and select an exam. Papers are arranged by year, with the latest papers shown first for quick access.

faqs.q: Are mock tests available?
faqs.a: Mock tests are being added to the site. Once available, you will find them in the Mocks section for regular practice.

faqs.q: Where can I find study notes?
faqs.a: Open the Notes section and choose a subject or chapter. Notes are grouped by topic to make revision easier and faster.

faqs.q: Where can I find video lectures?
faqs.a: Open the Videos section to find useful lectures organised by subject and topic. You can use them for learning or quick revision.

faqs.q: How should I start preparing for NIMCET?
faqs.a: Start with the syllabus and build your basics first. Then practise questions, solve PYQs and slowly move towards timed mock tests.

faqs.q: Which subject should I study first?
faqs.a: Start with Mathematics if it is your weakest area. Build the basics, practise regularly and then give more time to your weak topics.

faqs.q: How important are NIMCET PYQs?
faqs.a: PYQs are very important because they show the exam style, repeated concepts and difficulty level. Solve them after learning each topic.

faqs.q: How should I use DPPs?
faqs.a: Use DPPs after finishing a topic. Try the questions yourself first, then review your mistakes and note the concepts you missed.

faqs.q: How can I improve my speed?
faqs.a: Practise with a timer and track the questions where you lose time. Regular timed practice will help you become faster without rushing.

faqs.q: What happens after the NIMCET exam?
faqs.a: After the result, eligible candidates take part in counselling and fill their institute preferences based on their rank.

faqs.q: Which institutes accept NIMCET scores?
faqs.a: Your NIMCET rank is used for counselling and admission to participating NITs and other institutes listed in the official brochure.

faqs.q: What is NIMCET counselling?
faqs.a: Counselling is the process where candidates choose institute preferences and receive seats based on rank, category and available seats.

faqs.q: Can I change my college preference later?
faqs.a: Preference changes depend on the counselling rules and the current round. Always check the official counselling instructions before making changes.

faqs.q: Is NIMCET rank important for admission?
faqs.a: Yes. Your rank plays a major role in seat allotment, along with your category, preferences and the seats available in each institute.

faqs.q: Is everything on this site free?
faqs.a: Yes. The resources linked here are free to access. The site simply collects and organises useful study material in one place.

faqs.q: Do I need an account to use the site?
faqs.a: No account is needed for the main resources. You can browse the site and access available study material without signing in.

faqs.q: Can I use the site on my phone?
faqs.a: Yes. The site is designed to work on phones, tablets and computers, so you can study from whichever device you prefer.

faqs.q: Can I download the study material?
faqs.a: If a resource provides a download option, you can download it from its source. Some resources may only be available for online viewing.

faqs.q: Where can I find exam updates?
faqs.a: Check the Updates section for important notices such as exam dates, admit cards, results and other NIMCET related announcements.
